# SwapChan

> Best-price token swap aggregator for same-chain and cross-chain swaps (0x, CoW, Velora, LI.FI, Across, Relay, Jupiter) on Ethereum, Base, Arbitrum, Optimism, Polygon, BNB Chain, Avalanche, Linea and Scroll, plus Solana, Bitcoin and Tron. Includes a memecoin scanner with risk checks.

## MCP server
- URL: https://mcp.swapchan.com/mcp (Streamable HTTP; stdio via `swapchan-mcp --stdio`)
- Tools: get_supported_chains, get_supported_tokens, get_quote, compare_routes, build_swap_tx, get_route_status, scan_new_tokens, scan_trending, scan_movers, token_risk, get_wallet_balances, check_approvals, build_revoke_tx, explain_transaction, get_gas, token_info, resolve_name, watch_token, list_watches, check_watches, unwatch_token, get_yields
- REST mirrors: https://api.swapchan.com/onchain/{balances,approvals,revoke,tx,gas,token,name,yields,watches}
- Setup guide: https://swapchan.com/agents

## find_money (read-only wallet scan)
- MCP tool find_money / GET https://api.swapchan.com/onchain/money?address= : ranked forgotten money with unsigned recovery transactions. SwapChan never signs, never holds keys, and cannot move funds.
- Coverage: Ethereum, Base, Arbitrum, Optimism, Polygon, BNB Chain, Avalanche, Linea and Scroll; 12 more EVM chains (zkSync, Gnosis, Mantle, Celo, Blast, Berachain, Sonic, Unichain, Fantom, Monad, Katana and HyperEVM: native, listed tokens, known-spender approvals); ETH forks ETC and ETHW; Solana; Tron; Bitcoin; Bitcoin forks and same-key coins BCH, BTG, LTC, DOGE and FTC; old coins DASH, DGB, RVN, VTC, VIA, QTUM, MONA, BSV, GRS, PPC, NVC, CLAM, RDD, BLK, Zcash transparent (t1), TRC, AUR, XPM and QRK, plus balances for NMC, POT, MEC and ANC; and balances on XRP, XLM, ALGO, ATOM (Cosmos Hub), DOT, TON, ADA and Signum. For Bitcoin-family coins it builds an unsigned sweep to an address you choose, which you sign offline in the coin's own wallet; old-coin sweeps are offered only after a Rust transaction library compiled to WebAssembly has built and verified them and an independent second decode agrees. Monero addresses are recognised but not checked.
- Unsigned sweeps: GET https://api.swapchan.com/onchain/utxo-sweep?coin=&from=&to= , page https://swapchan.com/recover?sweep=utxo&coin=&from=
- Liquidity/Pendle exits carry live-quoted minimum outputs (1% slippage) and a 20-minute deadline; submitting through a private RPC is recommended.
- Guide: https://swapchan.com/find-money/guide
- Lost the wallet app? MCP recovery_guide / https://swapchan.com/recover: the human runs open-source blocktools (https://github.com/TSavo/blocktools; Linux x86_64 release v0.1.1 at https://github.com/TSavo/blocktools/releases/tag/v0.1.1, verify with `sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS`; other systems build from source) OFFLINE, e.g. `seed-to-master < seed.txt | derive --preset scan-js --address-list > addresses.txt`, and pastes only the PUBLIC addresses.txt into find_money_batch. Never paste a seed or key; SwapChan never sees keys.
- blocktools CLI docs, recipes and commands (open source, MIT, v0.1.1): https://swapchan.com/blocktools

## Developer & chain tools (public input only)
- Pages: https://swapchan.com/tools/validate-address, https://swapchan.com/tools/convert-address, https://swapchan.com/tools/cashaddr, https://swapchan.com/tools/xpub-addresses, https://swapchan.com/tools/ss58, https://swapchan.com/tools/solana-pda, https://swapchan.com/tools/address-script, https://swapchan.com/tools/hash-tools, https://swapchan.com/tools/polkadot-storage-key, https://swapchan.com/tools/anchor-discriminator, https://swapchan.com/tools/chain-params, https://swapchan.com/tools/tron-tx, https://swapchan.com/tools/evm-abi, https://swapchan.com/tools/create-address, https://swapchan.com/tools/bytecode-inspect, https://swapchan.com/tools/typed-data-verify, https://swapchan.com/tools/supported-chains
- REST: POST https://api.swapchan.com/tools/{fn} with JSON input (same functions as the pages). Public data only; private keys, xprvs and seed phrases are refused.
- Address formats per chain (version bytes, bech32 prefix, checksum, decimals, examples, live validator): https://swapchan.com/chains (one page per chain, e.g. https://swapchan.com/chains/bitcoin, https://swapchan.com/chains/dogecoin)

## Earn with SwapChan (agent builders, bots, sites)
- 5 bp (half of SwapChan's 0.1% fee) on every swap routed with your partner id, when the provider verifies the fee.
- Register: POST https://api.swapchan.com/partners with JSON {"name","siteUrl","evmAddress","solanaAddress"?} -> {id, token, dashboardUrl}. Use the operator's own payout address; never invent one. Self-referrals don't count.
- Then pass `partner=<id>` to MCP get_quote/compare_routes or REST /quotes. swapUrl carries ?ref=<id> (30-day attribution on swapchan.com).
- Details: https://swapchan.com/partners, https://swapchan.com/agents#earn, widget: https://swapchan.com/widget

## REST API
- Base: https://api.swapchan.com
- GET /chains, GET /tokens?chainId=, GET /token?chainId=&address= (any ERC-20 or SPL mint), GET /quotes, GET /quote, POST /build, GET /status
- Scanner: GET /scanner/new, /scanner/trending, /scanner/movers (?chain=solana|base|bnb|eth|arbitrum|polygon|optimism|avalanche|all&minLiquidityUsd=&maxAgeHours=&minVolumeUsd=&window=m5|h1|h6|h24&limit=), GET /scanner/risk?chain=&address=
- Scanner page: https://swapchan.com/scanner
- Example: GET https://api.swapchan.com/quotes?fromChainId=1&toChainId=8453&fromToken=0xA0b86991c6218b36c1d19D4a2e9Eb0cE3606eB48&toToken=0x833589fCD6eDb6E08f4c7C32D4f71b54bdA02913&amount=100000000&slippageBps=50
- Auth: optional `x-api-key` header for higher limits.
